snippet.title: Wonder Boy - ZX Spectrum 128k - (Sega, Activision 1987) - Random Gameplay
snippet.description:
A pretty decent run on Wonder Boy on the ZX Spectrum...a game converted from the Sega arcade original in 1987 by Activision.

I can't believe I can still adjust to that hideous scrolling! But this was one of the very first games I ever had for my Spectrum, and I got it free with Your Sinclair magazine!
